notes: Static native UI audit at the repository snapshot, not verification of released availability or a runtime test.
No means the inspected native composition omits the control or an explicit gate excludes it; it is not an assertion that the underlying SDK/protocol cannot perform the operation.
Conditional reasons include network, asset data, device authorization and experiment gating. A different native entry location is recorded where the user outcome exists.
The native send form has field-array scaffolding but its Add output control is explicitly TODO; do not infer multi-recipient support from the array.
The native custom fee component explicitly excludes Solana and Tron. Native EIP-1559 and legacy EVM custom-fee controls are present.
No Suite-native NFT viewing/sending, general transaction-history export, raw transaction broadcasting, general fee speed-up or desktop anonymity grouping was inferred from shared services.

Native signing can select Cardano COSE format but its visible result is the signature; a separate copyable public-key field was not found in the complete SignMessageCard/useSignMessageForm composition.
Native asset-first Home is gated by assetFirstHomeTableMobile. Portfolio value-change remains in the legacy graph header; it is absent from the current asset-first total-balance header.
